samples.identification: DismHost PE carrier containing an ASPack-packed VB6 disk binder/infector
evidence: Outer PE entry RVA 0xf3cc has conventional MSVC startup. Appended images are distinct evidence; not every image is established to execute from that entry.

Carved the VB6 image at file offset 0x2af9ef. Its original sections are writable and non-executable. Unicorn emulation of the ASPack stub, with WinAPI calls stubbed, reconstructs native VB6 code and transfers to 0x4014d8. No Windows payload was executed.

Unpacked 0x403356 reads one executable into an array; 0x40348d reads a second; 0x4035aa opens output and 0x4035bb / 0x4035d7 write both buffers using __vbaPutOwner3 and __vbaPutOwner4. 0x404320 sets the executable selection pattern to *.exe.

Unpacked 0x40451a / 0x40453d / 0x40454f create and write autorun.inf, including an executable shell target. 0x4045c9 copies the carried executable to the drive. 0x403a7d through 0x403b05 construct a Run value and invoke WScript.Shell RegWrite.

The separate image at 0x29db96 has high-entropy relocation bytes and a declared relocation overhang. Those measurements alone establish neither encryption nor activation. A certificate-directory entry establishes neither a valid signature nor trust abuse.

coverage.reason: Packed original bytes expose structural evidence; concrete infector actions were established only after manual unpacking. Do not upgrade metadata to meet a hostile-trait quota.

samples.identification: github.com/unxed/zipper v0.1.167 Go archiver source distribution
evidence: main.go dispatches user-selected create, extract, list, append, delete and repair commands. The only package initializer reads build-version metadata.
archive/fs.go hashes the archive path to form a deterministic local TAR-index cache filename. This is not CI environment access or exfiltration.

archive/factory.go selects archive handlers and spools standard input to a temporary file. Archive adapters implement password, compression, split-volume and recovery options; cleanup removes their temporary files.
perf_test.go invokes archivers with argument vectors for benchmark comparisons. Its unzip -d output-directory argument does not name or start Docker.
cli_zipper.go declares independent encryption and seek-chunk options on adjacent lines. Proximity alone does not establish an encryption chunk-size parameter.
archive/password.go searches error strings for password/encryption wording to classify password failures; this is ordinary error handling.

The GitHub Actions workflow checks out, tests, builds, packages and publishes the project. README links include twenty HTTP link spans to builds and dependencies, not evidence of a curated third-party-services catalog.
No hostile finding was attributed to a fetched dependency. The reported false positives arise in this archive itself.
samples.marker_line: Zipper v0.1.167: fix unzip -d Docker hit and hash placement

samples.identification: StormAttack native service-DLL injector with a damaged embedded payload
evidence: MSVC startup 0x4027a3 calls 0x401cb0. Its configuration mode at 0x404120 equals 3, selecting the Active Setup path at 0x401f8a -> 0x401900, followed by self-delete setup.
0x401a26 creates an HKLM Active Setup component; 0x401a4b writes StubPath. 0x401a69 through 0x401b26 read, patch and write a self-copy through CRT file I/O.
An alternate mode opens LanmanServer Parameters at 0x401310, deletes ServiceDLL at 0x401320, and replaces it at 0x40133e with its own DLL path.

0x402493 through 0x4024f6 extract resource bytes to a file. The injector calls CreateProcessA at 0x40119d, VirtualAllocEx at 0x4011d1, WriteProcessMemory at 0x4011f5, resolves LoadLibraryA at 0x40121a, then passes that address and the remote DLL-path buffer to CreateRemoteThread at 0x40123d.
0x401390 constructs a COMSPEC /c del command from its own short module path. The .htext jumps contain long self-move and self-exchange padding and return to the loader paths.

The embedded DLL at file offset 0x5060 is largely zeroed, with no useful recovered code/imports. Its StormAttack banners corroborate identity but do not prove working DDoS, theft, encryption or ransomware behavior.

pe: Original nested PE retains high-entropy-reloc-overhang; zeroing its .reloc bytes removes that finding.
Renaming .reloc while retaining its bytes removes the exact-section finding.
Breaking the MZ comparison bytes removes rip-relative-mz-header-comparison while preserving relocation evidence.
Replacing UTF-16 servertool.exe removes the filename-reference observation.

scope_note: Unsupported hostile composites were retired; neutral observations remain. Filename, hash, and source-name predicates were relocated or consolidated. PyCharm .sh/.app spelling variants were consolidated with identical scope to retain the executable-path leaf budget.
